author: Ben

changes: Email, URL, and phone number extraction with validation
Reading time estimation with customizable WPM
Secure password generation with customizable options
Word and character counting with detailed metrics
Levenshtein distance calculation for string comparison

description: Advanced text processing and string manipulation module written in Go and compiled to WebAssembly. Features comprehensive string utilities, text analysis, pattern extraction, case conversion, similarity algorithms, and text validation. Optimized for GoWM integration.

errorHandling.description: Text module returns error strings when operations fail, otherwise returns the processed result or analysis object
errorHandling.detection: if (typeof result === 'string' && result.startsWith('Error:')) { /* handle error */ } else { /* use result */ }

examples.error: Error: two arguments required for textSimilarity
Error: two arguments required for levenshteinDistance
Error: one or two arguments required for readingTime

examples.cause: Called any single-argument function without providing argument

errorHandling.pattern: string-based for errors, mixed return types for success
